evidence.quote:
verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it

observations.why: Quill asserts calibration authority by citing verification against reference plates — supplying controlled facts (informational) and grounding the claim in demonstrated expertise (expert).
Xena frames and supplies the factual record of decisions, controlling the informational substrate without invoking rank or process authority.

mints.title: verified the calibration against the June reference plates
mints.frame: Is authority here claimed by citing a verification procedure against an established reference, rather than by rank or assertion alone?
